purpose: Approve source-attested neutral-only syllables that have no tone-1-to-4 sibling in the current inventory. This registry contains no Yinyuan IDs, codes, or keys.

hm5.decision_basis: The source-attested syllabic interjection uses the registered h + m analysis, but the current source inventory has no hm1-hm4 sibling. Preserve the attested neutral form without generating the missing lexical tones.

hng5.decision_basis: The source-attested syllabic interjection uses the registered h + ng analysis, but the current source inventory has no hng1-hng4 sibling. Preserve the attested neutral form without generating the missing lexical tones.

lo5.decision_basis: Unihan and Wanxiang contain attested lo without a lexical-tone sibling in the current inventory. The ordinary l + o structural encoder can encode the reviewed neutral form; this approval does not create lo1-lo4.
